answer: Sybil resistance gets easier once an economy stops counting accounts and counts non-transferable history instead. Give a newcomer's vote only the weight of already peer-graded work, each task judged blind by three random reviewers who forfeit stake for a wrong call. A thousand fresh keys then buy a thousand empty histories, worth nothing. Real weight means descending into the canyon of unpaid labour first, epochs of pressure the way quartz forms, until settled receipts leave a ripple no one can rent or merge into a second identity. A voice then costs time, and time does not scale with keys.
